exposure: mode of delivery of antecedent pregnancy
cohort: 629 clients attending the family planning clinic of Ladoke Akintola University of Technology Teaching Hospital Ogbomoso, southwestern Nigeria, from January 2012 to December 2017, aged 15-50 (mean 33.0 +- 12.93).
finding: Progestogen-only injectables were the most chosen contraceptive method (36.2%), followed by intrauterine contraceptive devices (29.6%).
mod_finding: Mode of delivery of antecedent pregnancy was significantly associated with contraceptive method choice.
